knowledge.text: The last day to add or drop a course without a transcript notation is October 30. The last day to withdraw from a course is December 11. Dates apply to the Winter Semester 2026/27 term. Check with Academic Operations for exceptions.
knowledge.title: Add and drop deadlines

knowledge.text: Final examinations for Winter Semester 2026/27 run from February 1 to February 20. The examination timetable is published by Examinations and Timetabling. Conflicts must be reported before the add and drop deadline.
knowledge.title: Final examination period

knowledge.text: A full-time load is 12 ECTS or more in a semester term. Taking more than 18 ECTS requires advisor approval. Course ECTS are shown beside each course title.
knowledge.title: Credit load policy

knowledge.text: The library is open 08:00 to 22:00 on weekdays. Group study rooms seat 4 to 8 people and can be reserved for up to 2 hours per day. Quiet floors are marked at the entrance.
knowledge.title: Library hours and study rooms

knowledge.text: Report Wi-Fi or classroom technology problems to the Computing Centre. Include the building, the room and the time. Outages are posted on the service status page.
knowledge.title: Wi-Fi and technology help

knowledge.text: Report heating, cooling, lighting, or accessibility problems to Building Services with the building and room. Urgent safety issues must be reported to campus safety instead.
knowledge.title: Reporting a building or room problem

knowledge.text: Student parking permits are sold online for the Winter Semester 2026/27 term. Campus shuttles run every 15 minutes on weekdays. Bicycle racks are located at each residence and the library.
knowledge.title: Parking and transportation

knowledge.text: Students who need academic accommodations should contact Accessibility Services early in the term. Instructors receive accommodation letters through the official process, not from students directly.
knowledge.title: Accessibility and accommodations
